name: Gweike G2 20W Fiber
tagline: Desktop fiber marker for metal and select plastics
tldr: Gweike G2 packages a 20W fiber galvo in a desktop form factor. Solid option if you want metal marking with Gweike ecosystem familiarity from their CO₂ lines.
mainObjective: Entry fiber marking on small metal parts

engraveExample.description: Filled logo on stainless steel plate

pros: Desktop fiber marker for metal and select plastics
Fiber marks metal : does not cut wood or acrylic
Work area 110 × 110 mm on this chassis
Reference engrave job on this module: ~4–9 min
cons: 20W fiber: slower on deep marks than higher-watt siblings if you run large stainless jobs
Upgrade path to 30W or 50W if metal throughput becomes the bottleneck
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 20W module on Gweike G2 Fiber. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Fix parts firmly; start with low power test squares on scrap metal. Rotary adds complexity : budget time to learn indexing.
primaryUse: Desktop fiber marking for jewelry-scale and test jobs
